gen-gf-sniglet-gf-gantari: Approachable from the first glance, Gantari reads like bent wire. Sniglet is the one to hold a page's attention with its stubby, uncurled endings, while Gantari does the quieter work of staying friendly line after line.
gen-gf-sniglet-gf-gayathri: Chunky, marker-drawn, unbothered by direction. Gayathri then settles into a plain sans texture, where light strokes fade back only slightly and open-ended curves keep a long stretch of text feeling lightly pressed, like letterpress.
gen-gf-sniglet-gf-google-sans: Google Sans opens things up with terminals pulled well back. Sniglet, level and commanding, adds the personality, and the pair's strongest quality is how that blunt-ended heading sits over a body with no thick-thin shift at all.
gen-gf-sniglet-gf-google-sans-flex: Sniglet's terminals stop short of curling back in, giving the heading a stubby, level presence. And Google Sans Flex, with stroke ends that look cut from one ribbon, makes the strongest part of the pair: a loud heading over a tidy, modern text.
gen-gf-sniglet-gf-gothic-a1: Distinctive, right away: Sniglet looks like twine pressed flat. Gothic A1 sits low beside it with a splayed c terminal, and that gap between rope-like heading and restrained text is the pair's strongest quality.
gen-gf-sniglet-gf-gotu: Sniglet draws with a technical pen's steadiness. Gotu, a plain sans with moderate thick-thin modulation, sturdy hairlines and open-mouthed e crossbars, keeps a longer stretch of text crisp and easy to follow.
gen-gf-sniglet-gf-gowun-dodum: Sniglet leads with blunt, uncurled terminals and a level, commanding beat across the line. And Gowun Dodum follows with a wide-mouthed a and smooth, tube-like strokes, so the heading speaks up while the text stays gentle.
gen-gf-sniglet-gf-gruppo: Professional in its restraint, Gruppo draws curve endings that never come near each other, set under a heading that stops short of curling. Sniglet is best at being noticed; Gruppo, a plain sans, is best at staying thin and out of the way.
gen-gf-sniglet-gf-gudea: Gudea draws curves as fine as a thread, with glass-clear gaps between terminal and stroke, which makes it modern and welcoming. Sniglet is best at commanding attention; Gudea is best at quietly carrying the sentences.
